verdict.rationale: Generating an app from visual or design input is a fair question for a coding agent like Slate, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions accepting sketches, images, or PDFs as input. The `@filename` references and a frontend-interface skill description are adjacent features and do not show design-to-app generation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
